g.text: 10 From AI funding to LST shareholder returns

g.text: Funding starts the chain. Projects, consumption, supply, market share and cash returns determine the outcome.

g.text: Seek experimental relevance, evidenced supply constraints and global access; test the valuation hurdle.

g.text: Evidence is needed at each step

g.text: Customer budgets → orders / repeat purchases → net consumption → utilization

g.text: → company share → recurring profit / free cash flow → growth priced into the stock
